persons.name: Dāmodara
persons.evidence: stotram idaṃ dāmodaro ʼkarot ... dāmadareṇedaṃ likhitaṃ stotram

date.as_written: guṇeṃdukṣoṇibhṛtkṣoṇī ‥ ‥ puṇyetra vatsare | māghe māsi site

notes: The chronogram guṇa (3), indu (1), kṣoṇibhṛt (7), kṣoṇī (1) yields 1713 (likely Vikrama Saṃvat = c. 1656 CE, or Śaka = c. 1791 CE). Dāmodara is stated both as the composer (stotram idaṃ dāmodaro ʼkarot) and the copyist (dāmadareṇedaṃ likhitaṃ).
